flags.description: Deploy Vault ACME endpoint + Caddy demo on KinD (enable/update only)
flags.name: --acme

flags.description: TTL for certs issued to Caddy via ACME (short = visible auto-renewal in the web page) (default "5m")
flags.name: --acme-cert-ttl string

flags.description: Allowed domains for 'hal-role' (default "hal.local,cluster.local,svc.cluster.local")
flags.name: --allowed-domains string

flags.description: Jetstack cert-manager Helm chart version (empty = latest)
flags.name: --cert-manager-version string

flags.description: Enable debug output
flags.name: --debug

flags.description: Simulate the execution without changing state
flags.name: --dry-run

flags.description: With --k8s/--acme update: also rebuild Root CA and Intermediate CA from scratch
flags.name: --force

flags.description: Require HSM-backed CAs; errors if Vault is not an HSM build (HSM mode is auto-detected otherwise)
flags.name: --hsm

flags.description: Vault mount path for the Intermediate CA (default "pki-int")
flags.name: --int-mount string

flags.description: Max TTL for the Intermediate CA (2 years) (default "17520h")
flags.name: --int-ttl string

flags.description: Deploy cert-manager PKI demo on Kubernetes (--pqc implies its own NGINX deployment)
flags.name: --k8s

flags.description: KinD node image (used only when creating a new cluster) (default "kindest/node:v1.36.1")
flags.name: --kind-node-image string

flags.description: Maximum TTL for leaf certificates issued by 'hal-role' (default "24h")
flags.name: --max-cert-ttl string

flags.description: Subnet for the hal-net Docker network on first creation (e.g. 10.89.3.0/24)
flags.name: --network-subnet string

flags.description: Force software-backed CAs even when Vault is an HSM build
flags.name: --no-hsm

flags.description: Use isolated ML-DSA-65 mutual TLS and ML-KEM-768 lab (implies Kubernetes)
flags.name: --pqc

flags.description: PQC workload certificate TTL (10s to 24h); automatically rotates at half lifetime (default "10s")
flags.name: --pqc-cert-ttl string

flags.description: Actual Kubernetes Service DNS domain (default "cluster.local")
flags.name: --pqc-cluster-domain string

flags.description: Stock NGINX image with njs and ML-DSA/ML-KEM-768 TLS support (default "docker.io/library/nginx@sha256:1dd3048a04f4b76ebd706c1bbb9df7d9d53b4f8253b32ce14467088c9b5ada0f")
flags.name: --pqc-image string

flags.description: Vault mount path for the Root CA (default "pki-root")
flags.name: --root-mount string

flags.description: Max TTL for the Root CA (5 years) (default "43800h")
flags.name: --root-ttl string

flags.description: PKCS#11 key label for the HMAC key (default "hal-pki-root-hmac-key")
flags.name: --softhsm-hmac-label string

flags.description: PKCS#11 key label for the CA signing key (default "hal-pki-root-key")
flags.name: --softhsm-key-label string

flags.description: Vault managed-key name registered at sys/managed-keys/pkcs11/<name> (default "hal-kms-root")
flags.name: --softhsm-managed-key string

flags.description: SoftHSM2 user PIN (default "1234")
flags.name: --softhsm-pin string

flags.description: SoftHSM2 SO (security officer) PIN (default "0000")
flags.name: --softhsm-so-pin string

flags.description: SoftHSM2 token label used during --init-token (default "hal-hsm-token")
flags.name: --softhsm-token-label string

flags.description: Caddy container image name (ACME/--acme demo) (default "caddy")
flags.name: --vault-pki-caddy-image string

flags.description: Caddy container image tag (ACME/--acme demo) (default "alpine")
flags.name: --vault-pki-caddy-tag string

flags.description: Demo backend container image name (cert-manager/--k8s demo) (default "nginx")
flags.name: --vault-pki-web-backend-image string

flags.description: Demo backend container image tag (cert-manager/--k8s demo) (default "alpine")
flags.name: --vault-pki-web-backend-tag string

flags.description: Show every sub-step instead of a single collapsing progress line
flags.name: --verbose

flags.description: help for pki
flags.name: -h, --help
